Idiomas con los que Tesseract lee los PD: Languages Tesseract reads scanned PDFs and images with, joined with + (e.g. spa+eng). Each one has to be installed in the OCR service.
Nombre del motor LLM que lee las páginas: Name of the LLM engine that reads the pages in the brains that turn the vision model on. It has to accept images. Empty: the default LLM engine.
Páginas que se leen con OCR como mucho e: Pages read with OCR at most in each document; the following ones are left without text and the document says so.
